python.imports:
import fluentqt
from PySide6.QtCore import Qt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QVBoxLayout
python.setup:
control = fluentqt.StackView(%PARENT%)
page = fluentqt.Card(control)
layout = QVBoxLayout(page)
layout.setContentsMargins(20, 16, 20, 16)
layout.setSpacing(8)
page_title = fluentqt.Label("Overview", page)
page_title.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.Subtitle)
layout.addWidget(page_title)
page_summary = fluentqt.Label("Browse workspace summary and open the detail page to inspect stack navigation.", page)
page_summary.setWordWrap(True)
page_summary.setTextColorRole(fluentqt.Label.TextColorRole.Secondary)
layout.addWidget(page_summary)
layout.addStretch()
next_button = fluentqt.Button("Open details", page)
next_button.setFluentStyle(fluentqt.Button.ButtonStyle.Accent)
layout.addWidget(next_button, 0, Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft)
details = fluentqt.Card(control)
details.setObjectName("playgroundDetails")
details_layout = QVBoxLayout(details)
details_layout.setContentsMargins(20, 16, 20, 16)
details_layout.setSpacing(8)
details_title = fluentqt.Label("Details", details)
details_title.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.Subtitle)
details_layout.addWidget(details_title)
details_summary = fluentqt.Label("Pushed onto the stack. Use Back or the property panel to return to the overview.", details)
details_summary.setWordWrap(True)
details_summary.setTextColorRole(fluentqt.Label.TextColorRole.Secondary)
details_layout.addWidget(details_summary)
details_layout.addStretch()
back = fluentqt.Button("Back", details)
details_layout.addWidget(back, 0, Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft)
details.hide()
next_button.clicked.connect(lambda: control.pushReparentedItem(details))
back.clicked.connect(lambda: control.pop())
control.pushOwnedItem(page)
